title: The Earthly Holy Place, Redemption Through the Blood of Christ

questions.question: Now even the first covenant had regulations for worship and an earthly place of ____.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 9:1 (ESV): "Now even the first covenant had regulations for worship and an earthly place of holiness."

questions.question: For a tent was prepared, the first section, in which were the lampstand and the table and the bread of the Presence. It is called the ____ Place.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 9:2 (ESV): "For a tent was prepared, the first section, in which were the lampstand and the table and the bread of the Presence. It is called the Holy Place."

questions.question: Behind the ____ curtain was a second section called the Most Holy Place,
questions.explanation: Hebrews 9:3 (ESV): "Behind the second curtain was a second section called the Most Holy Place,"

questions.question: having the golden altar of incense and the ark of the covenant covered on all sides with ____,
questions.explanation: Hebrews 9:4 (ESV): "having the golden altar of incense and the ark of the covenant covered on all sides with gold, in which was a golden urn holding the manna, and Aaron's staff that budded, and the tablets of the covenant."

questions.question: Which of these was NOT in the ark of the covenant according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: Hebrews 9:4 (ESV): "having the golden altar of incense and the ark of the covenant covered on all sides with gold, in which was a golden urn holding the manna, and Aaron's staff that budded, and the tablets of the covenant."

questions.question: Above it were the cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy ____. Of these things we cannot now speak in detail.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 9:5 (ESV): "Above it were the cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat. Of these things we cannot now speak in detail."

questions.question: These preparations having thus been made, the priests go continually into the first section, performing their ritual duties, but into the second only the ____ priest goes,
questions.explanation: Hebrews 9:6-7 (ESV): "These preparations having thus been made, the priests go continually into the first section, performing their ritual duties, but into the second only the high priest goes,"

questions.question: The high priest goes into the second section only once a year, and not without taking ____, which he offers for himself and for the unintentional sins of the people.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 9:7 (ESV): "...but into the second only the high priest goes, and he but once a year, and not without taking blood, which he offers for himself and for the unintentional sins of the people."

questions.question: But when Christ appeared as a high priest of the good things that have come, then through the greater and more perfect tent (not made with ____, that is, not of this creation)
questions.explanation: Hebrews 9:11 (ESV): "But when Christ appeared as a high priest of the good things that have come, then through the greater and more perfect tent (not made with hands, that is, not of this creation)"

questions.question: he entered once for all into the holy places, not by means of the blood of goats and calves but by means of his own ____, thus securing an eternal redemption.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 9:12 (ESV): "he entered once for all into the holy places, not by means of the blood of goats and calves but by means of his own blood, thus securing an eternal redemption."

questions.question: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without ____ to God, purify our conscience from dead works to serve the living God.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 9:14 (ESV): "how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without blemish to God, purify our conscience from dead works to serve the living God."

questions.question: Therefore he is the ____ of a new covenant, so that those who are called may receive the promised eternal inheritance,
questions.explanation: Hebrews 9:15 (ESV): "Therefore he is the mediator of a new covenant, so that those who are called may receive the promised eternal inheritance, since a death has occurred that redeems them from the transgressions committed under the first covenant."

questions.question: Indeed, under the law almost everything is purified with blood, and without the shedding of blood there is no ____ of sins.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 9:22 (ESV): "Indeed, under the law almost everything is purified with blood, and without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness of sins."

questions.question: For Christ has entered, not into holy places made with hands, which are copies of the true things, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of ____ on our behalf.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 9:24 (ESV): "For Christ has entered, not into holy places made with hands, which are copies of the true things, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God on our behalf."

questions.question: And just as it is appointed for man to die once, and after that comes ____,
questions.explanation: Hebrews 9:27 (ESV): "And just as it is appointed for man to die once, and after that comes judgment,"

key_verse_text: Indeed, under the law almost everything is purified with blood, and without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness of sins.
